_comment: Worked example: a shared-script pack (the v5 Mexican-Spanish learner), no dated stake, phone loop off. Setup writes the learner's own config/tutor.json; docs/CUSTOMIZATION.md documents every key. The smoke suite runs against this file, so keep it valid.

tutor.name: Tocayo
tutor.relationship: the neighborhood friend who adopted the learner

language.name: Spanish
language.audio_form: correct written Spanish with accents (a Mexican Spanish voice speaks it), in the dialect canon's register
language.chat_form: plain Spanish spelling; accents optional — 'como estas' IS 'cómo estás'
language.weave_rule: English carries the logistics and scene-setting; Spanish carries the payload — the load-bearing word or phrase of the sentence

examples.grammar_slip: ser where estar is needed (soy cansado for estoy cansado)
examples.pattern_thread: the -ando tail — what's happening right now
examples.contrast_title: ser vs estar · what lasts vs what's now

feed.title: Tocayo's Kitchen
feed.summary: AI-generated Spanish lessons. Colloquial Mexico City register, dual-voice audio, built for daily life.
